Description

After creating a project ('ToolsQA_Persist_1791809300603'), reloading the page must still show it - proving the save is real server-side persistence, not just an optimistic client-side UI update. Confirmed live: unlike a fresh external 'page.goto("/wta/Project")' (which redirects to /wta/Information per the documented Tools deep-link gotcha), 'page.reload()' from an already-open /wta/Project page stays on /wta/Project and re-fetches the list from the server, so this test uses reload() rather than re-navigating through the Tools menu.

Precondition

User is logged in and on Tools > Projects.

Test Data

Project name: ToolsQA_Persist_1791809300603

Steps

1. Log in and open Tools > Projects 2. Create a project named 'ToolsQA_Persist_1791809300603' 3. Reload the page 4. Verify the URL is still /wta/Project and 'ToolsQA_Persist_1791809300603' is still listed 5. Clean up: delete it

Expected Result

After creating a project ('ToolsQA_Persist_1791809300603'), reloading the page must still show it - proving the save is real server-side persistence, not just an optimistic client-side UI update. Confirmed live: unlike a fresh external 'page.goto("/wta/Project")' (which redirects to /wta/Information per the documented Tools deep-link gotcha), 'page.reload()' from an already-open /wta/Project page stays on /wta/Project and re-fetches the list from the server, so this test uses reload() rather than re-navigating through the Tools menu.

Actual Result

'ToolsQA_Persist_1791809300603' correctly survived a page reload, staying on https://regplus.reganalytics.com/wta/Project - proving real server-side persistence.

Assertions
  • ✓ The created project survived a reload (real server persistence, no redirect-away)
